name: fine-tune-card
title: Fine-tune Card
summary: A small inspector for the last adjustments to something an agent made.
description: A compact inspector an agent hands over for the last adjustments to what it made. It holds a layout switch (our segmented control), scrubbable number fields and a type picker (our select). Drag a field's label to scrub it, or type, or use the arrow and page keys; the value never changes width. Once anything differs from where the card started, the header's "Adjust" hint crossfades to "Edited" with a Reset action, without moving anything. Number fields run the Zag number-input machine, through Ark UI's NumberInput in React, Vue and Svelte.

anatomy.description: data-slot="fine-tune-card"; changed (anything differs from where the card started) is a recipe variant
One grid cell holding both the hint and the edited group, so the swap never moves the header
"Adjust": the real Shimmer (speed fast, tone accent), marked data-fine-tune-card="hint-text"; plain accent text under reduced motion
Shown once something changes: the edited text and the Reset action
The real Button (ghost sm), marked data-fine-tune-card="reset"; restores every field default and the layout and type the card started with, then focuses the selected layout segment
role=status, visually hidden (sr-only); says "Edited" when the card becomes edited
The real SegmentedControl (sm, fill, icons), marked data-fine-tune-card="layout"

Number-input root, the shared control (`lib/control.ts`: sm, subtle; the ring for any focus); data-key; changed (differs from its default) is a recipe variant; data-focus, data-scrubbing, data-invalid from the engine
Number-input scrubber around the label: press and drag sideways to change the value
The real Select (sm, subtle, opens upwards at the end), marked data-fine-tune-card="type" on its root

fields.description: The number properties, laid out in pairs. `value` is the default, the value Reset returns to. Defaults to W, H, Radius, Opacity.

values.description: Current value per field key. A missing key shows the field's default.

layout.description: Selected layout segment (reaches the segmented control, not the card's CSS).

type.description: Selected type, or null for the placeholder.

types.description: Options of the type picker. Strings are accepted as value = label. Defaults to Default, Featured, Compact.

changed.description: Shows the edited state and Reset. Uncontrolled it follows the card: true while the layout, the type or any field differs from where the card started; the change event reports every flip.

labels.description: Copy: title, layout, row, col, grid, type, placeholder, adjust, edited, reset.

a11y.role: group of controls: radiogroup (layout), spinbuttons (fields), combobox (type)
keyboard: Tab moves through the layout switch (one stop), each field, Reset when shown, and the type picker
Layout: ArrowLeft / ArrowRight select, Home / End jump
Field: ArrowUp / ArrowDown change by one step, with Shift by ten; Page Up / Page Down by ten; Home / End go to the minimum / maximum; typing enters a value, clamped on blur
Type: the select contract (Enter / Space / ArrowDown open, arrows move, Enter selects, Escape closes)
Reset: Enter / Space; focus then moves to the selected layout segment
notes: Each field's label is its input's label; the scrubber only adds the drag.
Scrubbing is a mouse gesture (pointer lock); on touch, type the value.
Becoming edited is announced once through the role=status region.

motion: hint ⇄ edited: opacity and a 2px blur crossfade over duration.base in one grid cell; no layout change
field changed / focus: background and ring over duration.base
hint text: the shared shimmer loop; stops under reduced motion
layout thumb and type popup: as in segmented-control and select
